description: Update a media item: the sort order of any item (lower sort_order appears first), or the URL of a video entry (https YouTube/Vimeo link only). This tool does not create entries: a video is added with set_metadata { video_url }. Use get_my_software_details to get media ids. Provide at least one of sort_order/url. Requires sign-in to your Crela account; your client asks you to connect when you first use it.

media_id.description: The id of the media item (from get_my_software_details response)

sort_order.description: Display position; lower values appear first

url.description: New video URL (video entries only; https YouTube/Vimeo)

name: update_media
title: Update a Crela media item
